items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: I was playing up there with Henry Horton, myself, Doug McCullum, Andrew Horton.

ctx.x: Henry Horton. I was playing up there with Henry Horton, myself, Doug McCullum, Andrew Horton. Who was fantastic at the home? I'd get those hands, who was fancy, you know, and John that's saying. We had a 17th band, but we could use two trumpets. He's telling the same. Can't think about who was playing piano with us up there. We had quite a few piano players, can't buy it. Well, we played upstairs, and saw Jackman doing this, and caught it, Jackman did, or when they, when they made the Rhythm Club. Well, we'd…
Must have been a bit of a big deal to broadcast then.
